name: Bloodtooth Neck procs on ranged or melee attacks (#11815, #12236, #13157, #13313)
contract: Every dummy carries Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0 and the world had no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs
skipped it. Tooltip: "Your ranged or melee attacks" (base) and "Ranged and Melee attacks ... (25sec.
internal cooldown)" (tiers). Flags 340 (melee and ranged auto attacks and abilities) as the merged T1 Shaman
3-piece row for "Attacks". Chance from each record: 10 base, 7 tiers (the tier tooltip text reads 10%; the
PR author ruled for the record). spell_proc_chance reads each loaded entry's chance, which equals the
record's ProcChance, and spell_proc_cooldown_ms reads each loaded cooldown. aura_proc_rate replays the
aura's native proc decision, including the roll, 40000 times on one synthetic event per check. It procs on a
landed melee auto attack, a landed melee ability (Heroic Strike 78), a landed ranged auto attack, a landed
ranged ability (Arcane Shot 3044), at the record's chance; it never procs on a landed direct magic spell
(Frostbolt 116), a periodic Shadow tick (Shadow Word: Pain 589). Before the repair the chance and cooldown
lookups fail with 'Spell has no proc entry' and every rate reads 0, so the discriminating checks fail
